name: Ssam
role: Canvas sketch loop with hot reload and export to PNG, GIF, PNG sequence, MP4 and WebM
summary: Creative-coding wrapper inspired by canvas-sketch: ssam(sketch, settings) gives an animation loop with playhead (0 to 1 loop position), time, frame and loopCount props, separate playback and export frame rates, and canvas export to image, GIF, PNG sequence, MP4 or WebM. Works with Canvas 2D, WebGL and Three.js, not p5.js. Vite-based with hot reload. Author calls it early stage.
use_when: Looping animation sketches with a playhead and built-in video or sequence export
Over canvas-sketch when MP4, GIF or PNG sequences are needed from the sketch itself
Canvas 2D or Three.js sketches in a Vite project
Git-tagged snapshots of a sketch during iteration
avoid_when: p5.js sketches: p5-js with an external capture harness
Frame-exact capture driven from outside: Playwright seeking, not in-page recording
Mature, large community and docs: canvas-sketch or p5.js
Non-canvas DOM or SVG motion: GSAP
notes: 2026-10-26: Export runs in-browser; whether it is frame-exact under external seeking was not verified. README does not mention ffmpeg.

assessment.rationale: Latest commit and npm 0.22.0 on 2025-11-04, just inside the 12-month window; will become slow after 2026-11-04 without a release. MIT; author calls it early stage.
